name: Aigan Suru Mahou Shoujo ~Shinjite Kudasai!~
original_name: 哀願する魔法少女 ～信じてください！～
source:
Yet I did believe her!

Half the human population is in grave danger because of one magical girl.
An evil organization uses an inescapable weapon of mass slaughter, the Magical Nanomaterial Weapon (MNW).

It was magical girl Rina, a symbol of justice, who committed the greatest treason against mankind in all history. Because the girl had leaked the secret data to the evil organization, the dire massacre weapon was created! There is only one week until the enemies fully complete it! To prevent the use of the weapon, the protagonist must find the location of the enemy base from the traitor, magical girl Rina.

But the protagonist, having fallen in love with Rina, couldn't believe that she had turned into a betrayer. He starts an investigation into whether it is true or false. He makes strenuous efforts to clear her name, yet only unfavorable evidences appears, proving the falsification of her records, past ties, and such.

He helplessly interrogates, persuades, and threatens her, yet Rina refuses to talk, only appealing that she does not know anything and wants him to believe her. Impatient top brasses ordered the protagonist to make her confess, even if he needed to resort to shameful acts. He is shaken, because there is no way it would be normal to sexually insult his love, even out of duty.

Nevertheless, he has finally violated her, irritated by her continuing to keep silent. "I know nothing! Do what you want, just forgive me!"—begs she. If he forgives her, she will bear any cruelties, no matter how harsh they will be, and will comply with every one of his demands.

The assault was escalating, and finally the organization's supercomputer was put to use. The protagonist analyzed Rina's body and found her erogenous zones, which he thoroughly stimulated. Covered by murky liquid and gasping for breath, layed Rina. He stared at her and found himself filled with darkish madness, raping her with pleasure.

The protagonist was astonished by the depth of darkness within himself; he was about to be engulfed by it. Yet there is a little time for humanity left. There is no turning back now. People are frightened by MN weapon, so it wouldn't be surprising if they raised several insurrections. More and more chaos was seeping into people's hearts, but the organization of justice was in the same situation.

There is only one way to help them all—to get the enemy base's whereabouts from Rina. No matter how much she begs for mercy, there is only one path left for the protagonist now. But even so, when he looks down at a frightened Rina, he cannot resist his desire.

"Is that really the right deed?"

translation:
可我确实相信她！

因为一名魔法少女，半数人类陷入致命危险。

邪恶组织使用一种无法逃脱的大规模屠杀武器——魔法纳米材料武器（MNW）。

魔法少女莉娜是正义的象征，却犯下了人类历史上最严重的叛逆。她把机密数据泄露给邪恶组织，导致这件可怕的屠杀武器被制造出来！敌人只需一周就能完成武器！为了阻止武器启动，主人公必须从叛徒魔法少女莉娜口中问出敌方基地的位置。

然而，爱上莉娜的主人公无法相信她会背叛。他开始调查事情真伪，努力为她洗清罪名，却只找到越来越不利的证据：档案被伪造、过去的关系遭到篡改，诸如此类。

他无力地审问、劝说、威胁她，但莉娜拒绝开口，只反复说自己什么都不知道，希望他相信自己。高层不耐烦地下令主人公让她招供，即便必须采取可耻手段。他动摇了，因为即使出于职责，也不可能正常地对所爱之人进行性侮辱。

然而，他因莉娜继续沉默而恼怒，最终侵犯了她。“我什么都不知道！你想做什么都行，求你原谅我！”她哀求道。只要他愿意原谅她，无论多么残酷，她都愿意承受，也会服从他的所有要求。

侵犯逐渐升级，组织的超级计算机终于投入使用。主人公分析莉娜的身体，找出她的敏感部位，并彻底刺激。莉娜浑身沾满浑浊液体，喘不过气地倒在地上。主人公凝视着她，心中被阴暗的疯狂填满，愉悦地强奸了她。

主人公惊讶于自己内心的黑暗深度，几乎要被吞噬。但人类还剩下一点时间。如今已经无法回头。人们因MN武器而恐慌，爆发多场起义也不足为奇。越来越多的混乱渗入人心，正义组织也面临同样处境。

拯救所有人的方法只有一个——从莉娜口中问出敌方基地的位置。无论她如何哀求宽恕，主人公都只剩下一条路。然而，当他俯视惊恐的莉娜时，仍无法抵抗自己的欲望。

“这真的是正确的行为吗？”
